text:
Aisha: FYI DeployBot raised a rollback candidate for staged rollout v4.2.3 -> signal: sudden p99 latency jump on staging region. Auto-rollback is armed but suppressed due to partial telemetry. Need quick decision: let it auto or do manual graceful rollback?
DeployBot: [rollback candidate] Signal: p99 jump 420ms (baseline 180ms) across 3/5 nodes. Confidence: low (sample count 47). Proposed action: wait 10m OR manual rollback to v4.2.2.
Marco (runtime): low confidence likely from a single noisy node. Suggest narrow check: if node errors > 1% OR p50 drift > 50ms across >2 nodes -> execute rollback. Else increase sampling and continue roll.
Ellen Ops: timeline: if we manual rollback, we should coordinate release notes and pin dedicated customers. Ben, can you prep a brief note for #release-notes?
Ben (docs): yes. short blurb ready if we abort. Draft: "Staged rollout to v4.2.3 paused and rolled back to v4.2.2 due to elevated tail latency in staging; investigating. No customer impact expected."
Claire (support): customer signals: none yet. We have one internal job flake reported by infra. Recommend hold and collect more samples for 8-10m.
Aisha: ok we'll hold but increase sampling and attach a hold banner. Marco, can you enable node-level traces and bump canary sampling to 40% for 8m?
Marco (runtime): doing it now: `deployctl sampling --scope staged --percent 40 --duration 8m` and `runtimectl trace --nodes 3 --level verbose`.
DeployBot: sampling increase applied. Auto-rollback timer paused while manual hold is active.
10m later...
Marco (runtime): samples look clean now except node-7 still shows p99 ~380ms with occasional E_CONN resets. Node-7 has older kernel patch; recommending we cordon node-7 and re-evaluate.
Ellen Ops: cordon node-7 then re-run roll tests. Marco, can you cordon?
Marco (runtime): cordon executed: `infractl cordon node-7` -> traffic shifted off node-7. Recomputed p99 across remaining nodes back to 190ms.
Aisha: nice. since cordon fixed it, no rollback needed. Ben, cancel the rollback note; post an update: "Staged rollout resumed after node cordon; tail latency returned to baseline."
Ben (docs): posted update to #release-notes and TOC.
DeployBot: auto-rollback canceled due to manual hold and remediation. Logged event RB-3011: node-flaky-detected.
Claire (support): updated internal ticket; no customer alerts required.
Aisha: follow-up: create a postmortem for node-7 hardware/kernel mismatch and add a DeployBot rule to detect per-node outliers (not global) to avoid noisy rollbacks. Assign to Marco + infra.
Marco (runtime): filing RB-3012 and assigning. Will also add heartbeat checks to DeployBot signals.
Aisha: closing thread. thanks all.
